نستشير (form X)
# نَسْتَشِيرُ (nastašīru) /nas.ta.ʃiː.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَشَارَ (istašāra)
# نَسْتَشِيرَ (nastašīra) /nas.ta.ʃiː.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَشَارَ (istašāra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
